info.title: FitOS API
info.description: Deterministic fitness engine API. Every number is computed in packages/core, never by a language model (spec §19.1).

bearerAuth.description: Required on every /v1 route except those marked public (§10).

post.summary: Exchange a Firebase ID token for an app session
post.description: Idempotent. Creates the user row on first sign-in and returns it on every later call. Identity is taken from the verified Bearer token; the body carries device context only.

delete.summary: Sign out: revoke every refresh token for the caller
delete.description: After this, the client must discard its tokens. Because verification checks revocation, an unexpired ID token issued before this call stops working too.

patch.summary: Partial profile update; recomputes targets if a formula input changed

put.summary: Replace the active goal; closes the old one and recomputes targets
Replace diet preferences. Allergies are a hard filter (§9.2); the list sent IS the list.

get.summary: Where the user is in onboarding, with every stored answer for pre-filling

post.summary: Submit one step. Any step may be (re-)answered at any time; the response is the new state.
Screen 7: compute real targets from the engine. 409 with the missing steps if not ready.

get.summary: Search the library. `equipment` is what you have; results are what you can perform with it.
Detail with muscles, alternatives and contraindications

put.summary: Replace the active programme with a custom one

post.summary: Generate from the profile (goal, experience, days, equipment, limitations); replaces the active programme

get.summary: The professional structure library (no exercises until previewed)
Preview a template with exercises for THIS profile; nothing is stored

post.summary: Apply a template as the active programme (same materialisation as the preview)

patch.summary: Edit one day of the active programme (name and/or exercises)

get.summary: Today's day (or rest) with per-set targets and last performance, plus any active session

post.summary: Start a session (idempotent on clientSessionId); 409 if another is active

get.summary: One session with its sets and, once completed, its summary

post.summary: Log 1–50 sets (idempotent on clientSetId); merge:true adds to a completed session (§33)
Add an exercise mid-session (idempotent on clientExerciseId)

patch.summary: Reorder, superset, replace or remove a session exercise

get.summary: Weekly hard sets per muscle vs the §12.3 landmarks (current + 3 ISO weeks), neglect, deload state
One lift: its last three sessions and the progression recommendation with its reason

post.summary: Accept the offered deload week (never applied without this)
Decline the offered deload week; not offered again for seven days
Abandon an active session (kept for history, never counts toward records)
